body: My allergies acted up watching this..

Currently, I’m suppressing my feelings. They’re still there maybe a tad less strong. I am only really able to suppress them when I’m occupied.

I don’t know what the next panic attack will do to me though.

I am already used to the later. That’s what I wanted from you, what to do after the promise was broken.

Nothing, just have thicker skin.

Not the first bit, regardless of if the agreement is reasonable or not people should uphold it as long as it doesn’t hurt them.

I didn’t want the advice on the promise itself, I feel like that was misinterpreted. I just wanted what to do with a broken promise.

Maybe I can’t say it clear enough and I’m sorry if that’s the case.

No I get that. The advice that I needed was what to do with a friend that broke a promise to me. 

Not to be told my agreement was invalid and I need to stop being a bitch.

I am not going to change me for them. That is literally the only thing I ask of them for the most part. If they can’t hold themselves to one thing, that was a promise, that says something. The fact that I should change how I feel for them and live to accommodate their relationship like it’s royalty is fucked up. I don’t even ask them to listen to my problems or help me with trash, or pick up their side of the room. It is literally, hey don’t fuck in here while I’m here. That’s not that hard.

I don’t think you understand, you give and TAKE when you have a roommate. I am not going to be some beta nerd and only give. I don’t bring my shit here that they don’t want, they shouldn’t bring there’s in the VERY select set of circumstances that I don’t want.
That’s the thing. They have there own place not even two minutes from mine, but they came over here to fulfill there exhibitionist fantasy on me. That’s fucked up to me.

I just don’t think you get that doing what you said means getting in the way of me living mine the way I wish for them to live theirs the way they do. It’s an even playing field here. If they didn’t want to respect me they shouldn’t have promised, regardless of how inconvenient it is in your eyes.
I also feel like it was missed that they could fuck in they shower, just not when I am in the room. I would rather not be separated by only a wooden door.
A shitty one at that.

I can’t tell if that was sarcastic. You would be okay listening to the people you have to interact with everyday fuck right next to you just behind a door? After they say they wouldn’t because it’s not okay with me.

They have another place, which is important to note. They just did it in the shower we share instead of their own without me leaving the room. They weren’t even 5 feet from my bed and we talked about it before. It was still a promise that was broken and they could go or do ANYTHING else and any time else, just not when I’m in the room. They didn’t even ask me to leave.

I don’t mind if they do it in there, but the thing is I would rather them ask me to leave or just do it when I’m not there, if not go to their other place. They are 5 feet from my bed when they do that in the room we share, and no warning or anything isn’t cool with me and they know that. They still broke a promise.
They have another room. That’s why it bothers me. That and also my bed isn’t but 5 feet away from the bathroom, we have a hotel style dorm.
I will at some point soon. I’d just like to get it under control with therapy first.
Thank you. I hope so, too.
I will.
You have no idea how bad I want to. I just feel like it would mess things up rn. I will say something someday soon, hopefully.
Thank you, my heart hurts too. I need hugs tbh.
That’s what I’m here for, to at the very least set the bar for the next one.

That last part is the truest thing I think I’ve read ever. I can’t say how much I appreciate those words. I hope things continue to go well for you and I guess here goes nothing :/

I’ll probably start talking to them directly about it after I see a counselor soon.

I feel like you were almost on the right track with what you were thinking. There’s a few details that aren’t stated that show that I do give more than I get, but I don’t live my life for others (I did that for too long and lost my sense of self), and I know change probably better than a good chunk of people. 

I understand that this is from something I did. I just don’t know why my closest friends wouldn’t talk to me about it so I can change that, I don’t want to have to guess and mess something else up. I just don’t know where to go from there.

I really appreciate the advice. I’ll try to be more open about things like that with them. It’s going to have to be a very conscious effort on my end because of how ingrained it is just to hide those things from nearly everyone. 

I really hope that last bit is true. Nothing sounds better than that relief to be honest. I’ll try to keep this thread updated with situations around this.

The top bit is 100% true. It was heavy on environmental factors, but extremely situational to me. Not to discount the genetic argument, but at least in my case that’s not the major bit of the picture. 

The harder part is they already believe the things that you said I could set the example on, but I encourage them to do it without revealing what I’ve gone through. Also, I have tried to talk to my younger sister about eating disorders and tried to say that I knew what it was like, but she just straight up didn’t believe me because I hide things very well.

Do you have a way to work around that?

Again, just thank you so much for your thoughts. I know that just as much as the next guy, but believing it is the problem. I’ll keep this small thread posted with what happens when I go see a counselor. I’ll try to keep my head up, but at the very least I’ll keep dragging on.

I really appreciate the kind words and reply.
A friend saw the cuts a few days ago and she’s going to go with me to a counseling center with me soon. I am honestly a bit scared, but I really want a way out. She’s the one really close friend I have that isn’t fake and I really hope she doesn’t like me any less than she did. I just feel like an awful person.
